My `tail` regex captures everything after `status`, i.e. ` --short && echo ok`, and `OPTS_ONLY_RE` doesn't allow `&& echo ok` (only allows `&&` followed by end). Let me fix both: capture whether `-C` was used; if so, skip. And treat `&&/;/||` as terminating the status args.
